verdict.rationale: Gunderson's employment and labor page names a partner nationally recognized for non-competition and non-solicitation agreements and trade-secret misappropriation, which covers employee-mobility and trade-secret disputes. Its self-serve proprietary information agreements also touch confidentiality programs. This is first-party, but it rests on one sentence about one partner rather than a documented practice. missing for 10: a dedicated trade-secret practice description, documented trade-secret litigation matters or outcomes, detail on confidentiality-program design work, and independent corroboration.

support.subject: As IP counsel, the firm documents trade-secret protection work — confidentiality programs, employee-mobility disputes, or trade-secret litigation

citations.quote: Among our team is a partner who is nationally recognized as one of the top lawyers handling matters involving non-competition and non-solicitation agreements and misappropriation of trade secrets.
clients self-serve complex agreements such as employment offer letters, proprietary information agreements, and invention assignment agreements quickly and efficiently
